name: Fano plane (SDFP, k=1)
source: Islam, 'Tracing the Effects of Symmetry in Hypergraphs On the Fredman-Khachiyan Algorithm', MSc thesis, SFU 2024, Definition 5.2.1, p.50
notes: Self-transversal: Tr(Fano) = Fano. Aut is PSL(3,2) of order 168. The thesis uses it to show the frequency bound is tight at n = 7, with every vertex at epsilon = 3/7 (Observation 5.2.3, p.54). Not conformal; its primal graph is the complete graph K7. Reproduces thesis Figure 5.2: 35 nodes under the modified variant.
